name: English
welcome:
Hello, dear user! 🙏

Welcome to the "Soliq Oliy Maktabi" complaints and feedback point. Here you can freely share any problem, suggestion, or opinion that concerns you. Your message will be forwarded to the relevant management, and the response will be sent to you here.

Please choose one of the topics below:
share_contact_prompt: To continue, please share your phone number and name using the button below. This is needed so we know who the message is from and can respond to you directly.
contact_received: ✅ Thank you! Your details have been received.
contact_must_be_own: ⚠️ Please share your own contact (not someone else's contact card).
topic_chosen:
You selected: {topic}

Now please describe your problem, suggestion, or opinion in as much detail as possible. The more precise your message, the faster and more effectively we can help.
received:
✅ Your message has been received.

Please wait a moment while it is being reviewed. As soon as a response is ready, it will be sent to you here.
answer_header: 📩 You have received a response to your message:
please_choose_topic_first: Please choose a topic first. Press /start.
generic_error: Sorry, an error occurred. Please try again shortly.
empty_message: Please write your message as text.
rate_limited: ⏳ You've sent too many messages. Please try again in about {minutes} min.
